body:
Migrated from docs/agent-memory/optimizations.md at v0.6.0 (entry dated 2026-09-19).

At `3f30a02`, `tools/gate-affected-select` marks 103 packages `unresolved` (`readers.go` `unresolved()`), so every non-empty change runs at least about 105 packages with `-p 1`. That is slower than `go test ./...` in parallel. 37 locate the root themselves (`runtime.Caller`/`os.Getwd`), and many others inherit it from a dependency, 10 of them via `cmd/corvint`. Candidate levers: move test root-location onto one shared helper whose result is bounded; or run the fast tier's `go test` without `-p 1` when the union is this wide. Done means a one-package change selects well under half the module, with rule (d) still fail-closed. Measurements are in the BUILD-LOG entry of 2026-09-19.

2026-10-01 AFP-V0-023 (PR https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/438, branch claude/ci-affected-selection at 8f7a8ba8 on origin/main 2aec8fec): the project-owned .corvint/test-read-scopes.json declares measured read scopes for 99 root-locating test packages (75 entries), so planner and selector select them through DECLARED_READ_SCOPE instead of the rule (d) floor; an invalid declaration fails closed to the full run. Full CI runs declared packages under the Landlock wrapper .github/testconfine (ABI>=2), so a too-narrow scope fails rather than under-selects. Replay of 16 recent merges: mean 200->166 packages selected (-17.1%), 5023->4543 package-seconds (-9.6%). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-01-declared-test-read-scopes.md; CEM .corvint/changes/6eec96cac12c30d6ccecbeec9659716d72e392c7.cem.json (52/52 supported, dogfood-check PASS, sealed); focused tests pass; one independent review, both should-fix findings fixed. NOT_RUN: hosted confined full CI run (needs admin ci-control-plane approval for .github at the exact head), make gate. This shrinks the rule (d) floor while keeping it fail-closed; the 'well under half the module for a one-package change' criterion is not yet re-measured at the merged head, so this stays open.
title: gate-affected: the rule (d) unresolved floor selects 103 packages on any dirty path
